canonical_project: Gui'an Midea Cloud Data Center Phase 1
notes: Phase 1 (A building + campus supporting works incl. diesel platform & gatehouse) total area 15,415.96 sqm; single data building can host 1,200 x 8kW racks / 70,000+ servers. Planned total investment ~RMB 1.355 bn; opened/commissioned by 2024 with reported operating PUE ~1.17. Listed among Gui'an DC cluster projects completing 2023. Capacity 9.6 MW = 1,200 racks x 8 kW (phase 1 design).
